hero.title: Connect, Share, Make a Difference
hero.subtitle: Join our community where giving meets receiving. Make a positive impact by sharing what you no longer need with those who need it most.

easyDonations.title: Easy Donations
easyDonations.description: Create listings for items you want to donate with just a few clicks

directCommunication.title: Direct Communication
directCommunication.description: Chat directly with donors or beneficiaries to coordinate donations

smartNotifications.title: Smart Notifications
smartNotifications.description: Get notified about new matching items and message updates

cta.title: Ready to make a difference?
cta.subtitle: Join thousands of others who are already making an impact in their communities.

sarah.name: Sarah Johnson
sarah.review: I've tried other donation platforms, both free and paid, and this app is the only one that I would recommend 10 out of 10 times. The community is amazing!

michael.name: Michael Chen
michael.review: 10 years ago, I struggled to find ways to donate items. This platform has made it so easy and efficient. Can't recommend enough!

emma.name: Emma Rodriguez
emma.review: Incredible platform. Professionally speaking it's life-saving. The direct communication feature makes coordinating donations seamless.

david.name: David Thompson
david.review: This app has become integral to my workflow and it keeps getting better and better. The seed rewards system is a great incentive!

lisa.name: Lisa Anderson
lisa.review: I run a small charity shop and some of the items I've received through this platform have been perfect for our community needs.

james.name: James Wilson
james.review: Brilliant digital solution, it's great to see technology being used for such a meaningful cause. The user experience is excellent!

resources.title: Find Items and Resources
resources.subtitle: We are here to help you find items and support today.
resources.quote: They're actually a lifeline. They've really helped with items and supplies.

exploreMore.description: Discover more ways to give and receive in your community.

list.title: List
list.description: Items are listed on the Givea marketplace. Alert emails are sent to all members who have registered and signed up to receive alerts.

chat.title: Chat
chat.description: Items are usually requested within 12-24 hours. The listing member chooses who the items go to. The members chat and agree on a collection date and time.

collect.title: Collect
collect.description: Items are collected by requesting members. Members fill out a feedback form. The information is used to create case studies and collect ESG data.
